derivative_generation_procedure.input_contract: Use only the already-sanitized bounded capture identified by source_capture_file_sha256 and source_capture_self_fingerprint; perform no live-system read.
operations: Verify the supplied capture SHA-256 and self-fingerprint before selecting replay material.
Select exactly the five pseudonymized configuration bodies and bounded label, group, zone, domain, and target membership evidence required by the replay.
Discard capture-only plan, audit, internal automation, and runtime-accounting identities; do not invent missing evidence or claim planning-snapshot equivalence.
Preserve Jinja syntax, whitespace, control flow, dataflow, list and mapping order, repeated relationships, and scalar types.
Compute configuration_set_sha256 and membership_evidence_sha256 from UTF-8 canonical JSON with sorted object keys and compact separators after sanitization.
derivative_generation_procedure.output_contract: Commit only the pseudonymized replay projection and its bounded provenance; exclude credentials, endpoints, secrets, raw household identities, and raw production records.
